items.title: Trump gives Iran 2–3 days to seal deal; warns strikes ready 'on a moment's notice'
items.summary: Trump set a 2–3 day deadline for Tehran to produce an acceptable peace deal, saying he expects resolution 'maybe Friday, Saturday, Sunday' or early next week, while warning full military strikes remain ready at a moment’s notice.

items.title: Tehran warns renewed US strikes would open 'new fronts' and bring 'many more surprises'
items.summary: Iran's government warned that any resumption of US military strikes would generate 'many more surprises' and open 'new fronts' in the conflict, pushing back against Trump's deadline.

items.title: Iran rial at 1,780,000 IRR/USD on May 20 — up 5,000 from yesterday, 11% below 2M portfolio threshold
items.source: web-search:Iran rial exchange rate today May 2026
items.summary: USD remittance rate in Iran's parallel market reached 1,780,000 IRR/USD on May 20, marginally higher than yesterday’s 1,775,000 and still approximately 11% below the 2,000,000 portfolio threshold tracked by D1 and F8.

items.title: Polymarket: US invasion before 2027 at 32% (up 4pp); peace deal June 30 at 30%; ceasefire through May 22 at 80%
items.summary: Polymarket Iran war markets as of May 20: US invasion before 2027 rose 4pp to 32% on Trump deadline news; June 30 peace deal eased 2pp to 30%; ceasefire continuation through May 22 holds at 80%.

items.title: Iran establishes 'Persian Gulf Strait Authority' to regulate all vessel passage through Hormuz
items.summary: Iran created the 'Persian Gulf Strait Authority,' a new regulatory body to formally govern passage of all military and commercial vessels through the Strait of Hormuz, institutionalizing IRGC control over the waterway.

items.title: Kuwait captures four IRGC-linked operatives who infiltrated Kuwaiti territory, Foreign Ministry confirms
items.summary: Kuwait's Foreign Ministry confirmed four individuals linked to Iran's IRGC were captured after infiltrating Kuwaiti territory, adding to regional tension as Gulf states pressure both sides toward a deal.

items.title: Hormuz transit at ~5% of pre-war average; only 191 vessels crossed in April; ~2,000 ships stranded in Gulf
items.summary: Hormuz shipping remains at approximately 5% of pre-war levels with 191 vessel crossings recorded in all of April; roughly 2,000 vessels remain stranded in the Gulf awaiting clearance.

items.title: CNN: Israel preparing strikes on Iranian nuclear facilities, a move that would break with Trump's diplomatic track
items.summary: CNN reported May 20 that Israel is preparing to strike Iranian nuclear facilities, an action that would sharply break from Trump's diplomatic efforts and risk significant escalation.
